raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates bilateral consolidation with multiple cystic lucencies (pseudocavitation), a radiological pattern highly characteristic of pneumonic-type lung adenocarcinoma (formerly bronchioloalveolar carcinoma). While infection can cause cavitation, the specific description of "pseudocavitation" within confluent consolidation strongly points to this malignancy.
